title: Auction creation during paused state due to entropy callback
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `ApiologyAuctionHouse` contract has a mechanism to pause its operations preventing new auctions from being created. The creation of an auction can only occur through the `ApiologyAuctionHouse::unpause` and `ApiologyAuctionHouse::settleCurrentAndCreateNewAuction` functions, and these two functions can only be executed if the contract is not paused.
